name: My Dreamy Darling Deathwish
source:
A short (7,000 words) yuri VN where you step into the shoes of Jessie Hall, a young adult who's developed an obsession on another girl who goes to her university. Will you be able to curb Jessie's obsession- And should you?

[From [url=https://nhitori.itch.io/my-dreamy-darling-deathwish]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一段简短的《yuri VN》（7,000字），你将扮演杰西·霍尔 (Jessie Hall) 的角色，她是一位年轻人，对另一个上大学的女孩产生了痴迷。你能抑制杰西的痴迷吗——你应该吗？

[来自[url=https://nhitori.itch.io/my-dreamy-darling-deathwish]itch.io[/url]]
